name: Transverse Myelitis
definition: Acute or subacute inflammatory spinal cord syndrome causing motor, sensory and autonomic dysfunction across a spinal level.

redFlags.item: Rapid respiratory or cervical cord involvement

investigations.principle: MRI spine with contrast and cause-directed brain MRI, CSF and laboratory evaluation are central.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Structural compression must be excluded before labeling symptoms inflammatory.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata/myelopathy phenotype may be documented only as a parallel framework.

patientEducation.summary: Acute or subacute inflammatory spinal cord syndrome causing motor, sensory and autonomic dysfunction across a spinal level.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
